svg.title: Standing waves on a string of length L, drawn as solid and dashed envelopes. Top three rows, a string fixed at both ends: the first harmonic, n equals 1, is one loop with L equal to half a wavelength; the second harmonic, n equals 2, is two loops with L equal to one wavelength; the third harmonic, n equals 3, is three loops with L equal to three halves of a wavelength. Bottom row, a string fixed at the left end and tied at the right end to a ring that slides on a pole: the first harmonic has a node at the fixed end and an antinode at the free end, with L equal to a quarter of a wavelength.
svg.text: one fixed end, one free end
